evidence.name: Screen field: Roundness of the bar corners
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Roundness of the bar corners" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Roundness of the bar corners
sections.description: Sets how rounded the bar's corners are, in pixels (default 12, only applies when the bar is shown). The default looks good on most screens; raise it for a softer, pill-like bar or set it to 0 for sharp corners. Match it to your buttons and cards so the bar looks like part of the design rather than an add-on.
